summary: A 1932 40-ft timber L-4 tower near Cle Elum, WA, abandoned about 1962 and gone by 1966-1975; the site is now a roadside viewpoint with a few footings.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says removed in 1966 and Rex's page says destroyed in 1966; Willhite says used until around 1962 and destroyed by 1975. The story reports the disagreement and does not pick one.
The register and Rex's page give a 40-foot tower; Willhite's 1934 panorama note gives 42 feet plus 15 feet on the cab roof. Height_m is the 40-foot figure converted, and the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Core facts (1932 build, about 1962 abandonment, 40-foot timber L-4 tower) agree across three pages; the removal year and height disagree. Firelookout's header reads R.I.P. 1934-1975, which conflicts with the 1932 build date; left out of the story. No source gives coordinates or elevation for the site, so the brief's lat/lon (47.12145, -120.93828) and elevation_m (1200.9) were not checked. No photos added: the photo credits give no image URLs or license. Willhite's page gives no visit date.
